result:
Stage complete — all three fixes verified, edge-case pass finished, build clean.

## s4-verify (Run 103) — 3/3 fixes hold, 0 new defects

**Fix re-verification**

| Commit | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `29c009a` custom_fields guard | **PASS** | 6/6 bad types → 400; valid object → 200; 0 of 13 leads corrupted |
| `add652c` disabled-button opacity | **PASS** | Caught the transient: `{disabled:true, opacity:"0.6"}` → `{disabled:false, "1"}` |
| `50fde1b` map dropdown hover | **PASS** | Real `mouse.move`, hover fires and reverts; confirmed in the **built** bundle |

Three things worth flagging:

- I confirmed the API server was actually running the fixed code before trusting anything (start `05:07:20` > `crm.js` mtime `05:06:56`) — there's no watcher on it.
- For `add652c` I initially got a false signal: `getComputedStyle` returned `0.6` on an *enabled* button, because `.auth-btn` has `transition: all .15s` and I read mid-transition. Reading `el.style.opacity` (what React rendered) gave the clean result.
- `add652c`'s commit message claims the Add Payment Method button is *permanently* dead when `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` is absent. **That key is set in this environment**, so only the ~1-frame load transient is reproducible here. The fix is correct either way, but the more severe half of that claim was never observable locally — I recorded that rather than laundering it into a pass.

**Edge cases** (first s4 in the logged history to reach this step — prior ones capped on turns)

- Navigation 18/18: each moves the URL, renders an `<h1>`, leaves exactly 1 `.nav-link.is-active`
- Back/forward 4/4 correct
- Empty states: `/leads` search → "No leads found"; `/tasks` renders "No tasks yet / Create your first task"
- Form validation: 3 create forms submitted fully empty fired **zero** `POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE` requests — two block via `disabled`, `/expenses` blocks natively
- 375px: `scrollWidth === clientWidth` on 8 routes, 0 overflow outside real scrollers

**Two tester-error traps I paid for and recorded:** there is no `<main>` element (the root is `.main-content`), so a `|| document.body` fallback silently measured the global Cmd-K palette and faked a clean empty-state pass on 8 routes; and `.main-content` doesn't exist at 375px on routes with an `isMobile` branch, which reads as a blank mobile screen when 34–84 nodes are actually painted.

**Build:** PASS, 8.42s, exit 0. **DB:** 0 new rows (the happy-path check used an identity merge, leaving the value byte-identical). **Console:** 2 errors app-wide, both the documented `/api/admin/overview` 403.

Committed `95b9cab` — the new regression harness plus eleven `.qa-r100-*` sweeps an earlier stage left untracked. Memory and the resume log are updated; the top item there is now `automationEngine.js:75-77`, an enum bug with a written repro that has been skipped for 8 runs because no stage was explicitly assigned it.
